sanitization: Full logs withheld. Exact native argv (installed executable path redacted), times, exit codes and full-output hashes retained. Excerpts keep numbered lines selected by error/advisory/test markers with neighboring lines, capped at last 90 selected lines; ANSI stripped, home paths and email addresses redacted. Decode excerpt_gzip_base64 for selection metadata and text; excerpt_sha256 covers decoded JSON.
